test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Efforts are being made by us to reduce crowding in core city areas.

options.text: We are making efforts to reduce crowding in core city areas.
We were making efforts to reduce crowding in core city areas.
We made efforts to reduce crowding in core city areas.
We will be making efforts to reduce crowding in core city areas.

solution: The correct answer is** 'We are making efforts to reduce crowding in core city areas'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is in the Passive Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Active Form. • The given sentence is an example of 'present continuous'. • The structure of these kinds of sentences is: • Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object. (Active Voice) • Subject(Objective Case) + is/am/are + being+ V3 + by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *He is riding a bike.* • *A bike is being ridden by him. * • The subject of the given sentence is 'Efforts' and the object of the given sentence is 'We (hidden object)'. • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. • Here, 'are being made' will be changed into 'are making'. • The preposition 'by' will be used in the end. Correct Sentence:__ *We are making efforts to reduce crowding in core city areas*. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य Passive Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें वाक्य को Active Voice में बदलना है। • दिया गया वाक्य 'present continuous' का उदाहरण है • इस प्रकार के वाक्यों की संरचना है: • Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object. (Active Voice) • Subject(Objective Case) + is/am/are + being+ V3 + by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) • उदाहरण: • *He is riding a bike.* • *A bike is being ridden by him. * • दिए गए वाक्य का विषय 'Efforts' है और दिए गए वाक्य का उद्देश्य 'We (object)' है। • Object के स्थान पर Subject रखा जाएगा और Subject के स्थान पर Object रखी जाएगी। • यहां, 'are being made' को 'are making' में बदल दिया जाएगा। • अंत में preposition' by' का प्रयोग किया जाएगा। fc:T14bc, The correct answer is **'Sumesh requested Raman to lend him some money as he needed it urgently'.**
